title: Psalms 70
paragraphs: ¹ Come quickly to help me, O God; LORD, hurry to my rescue. ² Let those who seek my life be ashamed and confused; let those who want to hurt me be turned back in disgrace. ³ Let those who say "Aha! Aha!" be turned back in shame. ⁴ Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; let those who love your salvation say continually, "Let God be magnified!" ⁵ But I am poor and needy — come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
